name: Ashley Oelsen
office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the City Council

items.text: Ashley Oelsen is a conservation biologist and a commissioner on Santa Monica's Commission on Sustainability, Environmental Justice and the Environment. She says she chairs the Clean Oceans and Beaches Measure V Oversight Committee. Her campaign focuses on a sustainable environment, sound city finances and safe streets.

sentences.text: Ashley Oelsen is a conservation biologist and a commissioner on Santa Monica's Commission on Sustainability, Environmental Justice and the Environment.
She says she chairs the Clean Oceans and Beaches Measure V Oversight Committee.
Her campaign focuses on a sustainable environment, sound city finances and safe streets.

items.text: She led community opposition to AB 1740, a bill that would have exempted Santa Monica from California Coastal Commission oversight. She opposes upzoning single-family neighborhoods, or any other areas until infrastructure and evacuation studies are completed and community input is gathered. She supports homelessness programs with measurable outcomes, including tracked job placement and retention rates. After the 2025 Palisades fire, she tested beach sand, finding heavy metals not present in pre-fire samples.
